description: MainActivity.kt defines the main entry point activity for the Android TV application. It sets up the UI, integrates Jetpack Compose for rendering the home screen, manages navigation, and handles key events such as remote control inputs.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity for Android TV, extending FragmentActivity to support Leanback and Compose integration, setting up the UI and handling remote input events.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, prepares the ComposeView with dummy content for home screen rendering.

methods.name: onKeyDown
methods.description: Handles remote key events such as navigation and selection.
